Join Siemens Energy – Powering the Future At Siemens Energy, we are driving the energy transition and addressing the greatest challenge of our generation: reducing emissions while increasing energy supply. With over 150 years of innovation, our dedicated team of 98,000 professionals across 90 countries is at the forefront of electrifying the world.
A Snapshot of Your DayTo support the growth of the Configure Price Quote (CPQ) Application Tools team within Siemens Energys Grid Technologies division, this role is established to deliver state-of-the-art software solutions that streamline product configuration and pricing processes. This role is responsible for developing and maintaining innovative software solutions that optimize product configuration and pricing processes. There are three key areas: agile software development and implementation, quality assurance and long-term code sustainability, and local customer support and coordination for the Berlin (Germany) and Wuxi (China) manufacturing sites. To succeed in this role, you should have a strong software engineering background, hands-on experience with Agile methodologies (particularly Scrum), and excellent communication skills to effectively
